g.text: 2-D Mars landing (g = 3.71 m/s²), thrust acceleration 2–6.5 m/s², within 60° of vertical, 10° glide slope. Convex: 40-step discretisation, ‖u‖ ≤ σ by
a 16-sided polygon, minimise Σσ Δt by linear programming (HiGHS) with a search over flight time. Polynomial: acceleration linear in time, best
